summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the presentation of Part 1 data from a Johnson & Johnson-sponsored Phase 2 trial evaluating JNJ-1900 (NBTXR3) in stage 3 inoperable lung cancer at the ESTRO 2026 meeting. The press release reports early safety and efficacy results, including an 85.7% overall response rate and 57.1% complete response rate in seven patients. No special-situation corporate transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical data by a foreign private issuer.
